# Vendor

## qrcode.min.js

- Project: [davidshimjs/qrcodejs](https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs)
- Version: 1.0.0
- Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js
- License: MIT

It is vendored so the staff card page and the public employee card work without a CDN
dependency, including on slow mobile connections and when printing.
